abstract: Text-to-audio generation (TTA) requires reliable evaluation of semantic alignment between generated audio and input text. Existing learning-based alignment-score prediction models have been evaluated only on audio generated by models included in the training data, leaving their generalization to unseen generation models unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the generalization of audio--text semantic-alignment score prediction models to unseen TTA models and introduce adversarial training using a generation-model classifier with a gradient reversal layer (GRL). Experimental results show that pretrained audio encoders capture generation-model-specific characteristics and that alignment-score prediction performance degrades on audio generated by unseen TTA models. Applying the GRL improves prediction performance in some settings, although its effectiveness in suppressing generation-model-specific information is limited.
oneSentenceThesis: 针对对齐分数预测在未见文本到音频生成模型上 SRCC 大幅下降的问题，本文用带梯度反转层的生成模型分类器做对抗训练，在固定分组下将未见组 SRCC 从 0.144 提升到 0.161 与从 0.210 提升到 0.241，但去痕效果仅在一组一配置下显现而整体增益有限且位置敏感。
originalTitle: Investigation of generalization to unseen audio generation models in audio--text semantic-alignment score prediction
readerTitle: 未见音频生成模型下的音频文本语义对齐分数预测泛化研究
